title: Virtual Compute: assisted review — invoice identity
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute assisted review — For a primary paid-line cash correction, the target is the most recently issued posted primary charge of the selected holding; the customer must identify that exact line.

Virtual Compute assisted review — Read the authoritative export reference attached to that most recent posted primary charge.

Virtual Compute assisted review — Use the UTC service service month of that most recent posted primary charge.

Virtual Compute assisted review — Read the original channel recorded on that most recent posted primary origin charge; the channel of the present support conversation does not replace the origin channel.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for assisted review — invoice identity?**

Read the original channel recorded on that most recent posted primary origin charge; the channel of the present support conversation does not replace the origin channel.
